DocumentRollup.Summary: List documents for many different purposes, with different views, filters and refiners.

DocumentLibrary.Summary: Add this to a page where you want to work with controlled documents.

Content.Summary: Display the process content - added on the Content tab by the process author.

Drawing.Summary: Display the process drawing for the process.

Tasks.Summary: Display tasks the process author added to the Tasks tab for the process.

ProcessStepStatus.Summary: Use it in a process context to set and view the status for a step in the process.

Links.Summary: Display the links the process author added to the Links tab for the process.

ProcessNavigation.Summary: It will add a current navigation-like navigation for the process steps.

ProcessContext.Summary: Use it to display a specific process on the page, based on a property.

ProcessRollup.Summary: List available processes, with filter possibilities.

Properties.Summary: Display properties for the process for end users, for example process owner.

Title.Summary: Display the process title, added for the process by the process author.

Breadcrumb.Summary: Use it to display a breadcrumb on a process page.

Documents.Summary: Display a list of documents - added on the Documents tab by the process author.

Pages.Summary: Lists the pages, added on the Pages tab by the process author.

ProcessLayout.Summary: Display the whole process on a page. Must be combined with the Process context block.
